function createAgreement(address freelancer, bytes32 termsHash, string termsURI, uint8 mode, uint16 latePenaltyBpsPerDay, uint16 maxLatePenaltyBps, uint32 reviewWindow, uint32 graceWindow, uint8 maxRevisions, uint256[] amounts, uint64[] deadlines, uint16[] requiredProgressBps, bytes32[] criteriaHashes) returns (uint256 id)
function acceptAgreement(uint256 id)
function fundAgreement(uint256 id) payable
function cancelUnfunded(uint256 id)
function submitMilestone(uint256 id, uint8 idx, bytes32 submissionHash, string commitSha)
function recordProgress(uint256 id, uint8 idx, uint16 aiProgressBps, bytes32 aiReportHash)
function approveMilestone(uint256 id, uint8 idx)
function rejectMilestone(uint256 id, uint8 idx, bytes32 reasonHash)
function claimAfterReviewWindow(uint256 id, uint8 idx)
function reclaimMissedMilestone(uint256 id, uint8 idx)
function proposeAmendment(uint256 id, uint8 idx, uint64 newDeadline, bytes32 newTermsHash, string newTermsURI)
function acceptAmendment(uint256 id, uint256 amendmentId)
function raiseDispute(uint256 id, uint8 idx, bytes32 evidenceHash)
function submitEvidence(uint256 id, uint8 idx, bytes32 evidenceHash)
function recordAiRecommendation(uint256 id, uint8 idx, uint16 freelancerShareBps, bytes32 reportHash)
function castVote(uint256 id, uint8 idx, uint16 freelancerShareBps)
function finalizeDispute(uint256 id, uint8 idx)
function addArbitrator(address arbitrator)
function removeArbitrator(address arbitrator)
function setOracle(address oracle)
function setTreasury(address treasury)
function setFeeBps(uint16 feeBps)
function pause()
function unpause()

function getAgreement(uint256 id) view returns (tuple(address client, address freelancer, bytes32 termsHash, string termsURI, uint8 status, uint8 mode, uint16 latePenaltyBpsPerDay, uint16 maxLatePenaltyBps, uint32 reviewWindow, uint32 graceWindow, uint8 maxRevisions, uint256 totalAmount, uint256 paidAmount, uint256 createdAt))

function getMilestone(uint256 id, uint8 idx) view returns (tuple(uint8 status, uint256 amount, uint64 deadline, uint16 requiredProgressBps, bytes32 criteriaHash, bytes32 submissionHash, string commitSha, uint16 aiProgressBps, bytes32 aiReportHash, uint64 submittedAt, uint8 revisionCount))
function getMilestoneCount(uint256 id) view returns (uint256)

function getDispute(uint256 id, uint8 idx) view returns (tuple(uint8 status, address raisedBy, bytes32 evidenceHash, address[3] arbitrators, uint8 votesCount, uint16 resolvedFreelancerShareBps, uint8 resolutionMethod))
function getPaymentSummary(uint256 id) view returns (uint256 locked, uint256 released, uint256 disputed, uint256 refunded, uint256 feesPaid)
event AgreementCreated(uint256 indexed id, address indexed client, address indexed freelancer, bytes32 termsHash, string termsURI)
event AgreementAccepted(uint256 indexed id)
event AgreementFunded(uint256 indexed id, uint256 amount)
event AgreementCancelled(uint256 indexed id)
event AgreementCompleted(uint256 indexed id)
event MilestoneSubmitted(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, bytes32 submissionHash, string commitSha)
event ProgressRecorded(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, uint16 aiProgressBps, bytes32 aiReportHash)
event MilestoneApproved(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, bool auto)
event MilestoneRejected(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, bytes32 reasonHash)
event MilestonePaid(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, uint256 freelancerAmount, uint256 fee, uint256 penaltyRefund)
event MilestoneRefunded(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, uint256 amount)
event AmendmentProposed(uint256 indexed id, uint256 indexed amendmentId, uint8 idx, uint64 newDeadline, bytes32 newTermsHash, string newTermsURI)
event AmendmentAccepted(uint256 indexed id, uint256 indexed amendmentId)
event DisputeRaised(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, address indexed by, bytes32 evidenceHash)
event EvidenceSubmitted(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, address indexed by, bytes32 evidenceHash)
event ArbitratorsSelected(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, address[3] arbitrators)
event VoteCast(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, address indexed arbitrator, uint16 freelancerShareBps)
event AiRecommendationRecorded(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, uint16 freelancerShareBps, bytes32 reportHash)
event DisputeResolved(uint256 indexed id, uint8 indexed idx, uint16 freelancerShareBps, uint8 method)
